book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Zereth Zerizaade Leemiso
Qasse Yesusi hara wode abbaa achchan tamaarso oykkides. Izakko keehi daro derey shiiqida gishshas abbaa giddon diza wogolo dizaarin gelidi uttides; asaykka wuri abbaa achchan shiiqides.
Izikka daro yo7ota leemison hizgi tamaarsides.
«Siyite! Issaadey zereth zeranaas kezides.
Izi zerishin issi issi zereththi oge bolla wodhdhides. Oge bolla wodhdhida zereththaa kafoti maxi mida.
Baggay mela biittan wodhdhides. He biittay mela gidida gishshas heerakka caarides.
Gido attiin arshey kezida mala shullidi xapho yeddontta gishshas melides.
Qasse issi zereththi agunththa giddon wodhdhides; agunththayka diccidi cuullida gishshas ayfibeenna.
Hara zereththi qasse lo7o orde biitta bolla wodhdhida gishshas caaridi diccides; ayfekka ayfides; Issoy heedzdzu tammu, issoy qasse usuppun tammu, issoy qasse xeetu ayfides.»
Yesusi qasseka, «Siyiza hayththi dizaadey siyo!» gides.
Yesusi Leemisora Yootiza Gaaso
Yesusi barkka dishin tammanne nam7atinne kase izara diza asay izi yootida leemisoza gishshas iza zaari oychchida.
Izikka isttas, «Inttes Xoossa Kawoteththa xuura eroy gelides shin karen dizaytas gidikko yo7oy wuri leemisora yootettees.
Hessika kase, ‹Istti be7idi be7idayssa akeekontta malanne simmontta mala, qasseka istta nagaray maarettontta malakko› » gides.
Qasseka Yesusi, «Hayssi leemisoy inttes gelibeennee? Histtiin hara leemiso intte wostti eranee?
Zerizaadey qaala zerees.
Issi issi asati oge bolla wodhdhida zereththaa misateettes; istti qaala siyiza wode Xala7ey yiidi heerakka istti siyida qaalaa istta wozinappe ekkichchees.
Hessaththoka harati mela biitta bolla wodhdhida zereththaa misateettes. Istti qaala siyidi ufayssan ekkeettes.
Gido attiin istti xapho yeddontta gishshas guuththa wode gam7ishin qaalaa gaason metoy woykko goodetay asata bolla yiza wode heerakka dhuphetteettes.
Harati qasse agunththa giddon wodhdhida zereththaa misateettes; istti qaalaa sis siyeettes.
Gido attiin ha biitta metoy, miishsha siiqoynne hara amoy istti siyida qaala cuullidi ayfe ayfontta mala diggees.
Hankkoyti lo7o biittan zerettida zereththaa misateettes; heytikka qaalaa siyidi ekkizaadenne heedzdzu tammu ayfe, usuppun tammu ayfenne xeetu ayfe ayfizayta» gides.
Geeman Diza Xomppe
Qasseka Yesusi, «Xomppe oyththidi geemason woykko arsa garsan woththi ereetii? Poo7ana mala qoncceson woththeeta gidennee?
Hessa gishshas qotettidi qoncce kezonttay, poo7on kezontta geeman attanay baa.
Hessa gishshas siyiza hayththi dizaadey siyo!» gides.
Gujjidikka, «Intte siyizayssa wozinan woththite; intte makkiza miishshara inttes makettana; hessafekka daroy gujettana.
Dizaades gujettana shin bayndaadefe izas dizaarakka ekketaychchana» gides.
Dicciza Zereththa Leemiso
Qasseka Yesusi, «Xoossa kawoteththiya zereth zeriza issi as misatawus.
Zeridaadey omars dhiskees. Wontishin dendees; gido attiin izi erontta dishin zerettida kaththay mokkidi diccees.
Gadeyakka koyro caarech, kaaleththada pudhe, qasseka pudheza bolla lo7o ayfe immawus.
Kaththay kaxxidaappe guye boney gakkiin keeththa aaway heerakka maxa oykkees» gides.
Sanafice Miththa Ayfe Leemiso
Yesusi, «Xoossa Kawoteth nu aazara ginisanee? Aazara leemisanee?
Biitta bolla ubbaafe laafa gidida sanafice ayfe misatawus.
Zerettada diccidaappe guye qasse atakilteta ubbaafe aadhdhiza gishshas kafoti yiidi he atakiltey haggata kuwa giddon shempeettes» gides.
Yesusikka asay ekkanaas dandayzayssa keena hayta misatiza hara daro leemisora isttas yootides.
Ay miish gidikkoka asaas leemisoy baynda yooti erenna. Izinne iza kaallizayti xalla diza wode gidikko wursi birshi yootees.
He gallas gadey qammishin bana kaallizayta, «Ane gede he pinth pinnoos» gides.
Istti asaa heen aggaagidi izi utti diza wogolozara Yesusa ekki bida. Hara wogolotikka isttara issife deettes.
He wode wolqqama dambalay abbaa bolla dendidi wogoloza haaththi kumana gakkanaas shocechchides.
Gido attiin Yesusi borkoth borkotidi wogolozas guye baggan ichchides. Isttika iza denththidi, «Astamaaree! Nuni dhayshin nena meettennee?» gida.
Izikka dendidi carkoza, «Co7u ga!» abbaaka, «Woppu ga!» gides; carkoyka co7u gides; mulekka co7u gides.
Bana kaallizaytakka, «Hayssaththo aazas babbidetii? Hayssa gakkanaas inttes ammanoy baawee?» gides.
Isttika keehi babbidi ba giddon issoy issaara, «Carkoynne abbay izas azazettizay hayssi oonee?» geetettida.
